subject: Re: MPL kickoff — status: both benchmarks in, one cost flag
body:
Status:

- CIFAR-10-4000: reproduced 03-04 with the wrn-28-2 config; we landed within 0.3% of the published accuracy. The UDA settings matter — Ondrej confirmed sensitivity to uda_threshold=0.6 and uda_weight=8; drifting those cost us a point in early runs.
- ImageNet-10%: resnet-50 run finished 04-05, accuracy within 0.5% of published. But the cost profile is the story: the teacher-student loop means every step trains two models plus the UDA batch, and our measured cost came in ~1.4x my original estimate for the full 300k-step schedule (the mpl_student_lr_wait_steps warmup interacts badly with our preemption rate — Chiara has a checkpoint-cadence fix that recovers most of it).

Flag: at measured cost, the Q3 scaled-run proposal lands right at the top of the budget envelope we discussed, with no room for reruns. Options in the 04-27 proposal: trim to 2 datasets, or seek headroom.

Umar
